about:
Millennium Renovation LLC is a professional residential and commercial remodeling company serving Houston, Dallas, and surrounding communities in Texas.

We specialize in flooring installation, interior and exterior painting, drywall installation, framing, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, and complete property renovations.

Our commitment is to deliver quality craftsmanship, reliable service, and exceptional results. Whether you're renovating your home, upgrading your business, or transforming a commercial property, Millennium Renovation LLC is dedicated to bringing your vision to life.
